title: Running VirSorter in iPlant Discovery Environment
author: Simon Roux
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.d8u9wv
materials: Select a directory to work in. a

steps.title: Log in to Discovery Environment
steps.instruction: Open a web browser, go to https://de.iplantcollaborative.org/de/ and sign in to the iPlant Discovery Environment, which hosts VirSorter.

steps.title: Upload input data
steps.instruction: In the left panel click the “Data” button, then click “Upload” and place your input files in the current directory.

steps.title: Open the Apps interface
steps.instruction: Click the “Apps” button to access the list of available applications.

steps.title: Set analysis name and output directory
steps.instruction: Enter a descriptive name for the run and select the desired output directory for the analysis results.

steps.title: Select input file and database
steps.instruction: In section 1, choose the input FASTA file and select a reference database (with or without viromes). Optionally, add a FASTA file of additional viral sequences and enable the ‘virome decontamination’ mode to identify viral sequences in predominantly viral datasets.

steps.title: Launch VirSorter analysis
steps.instruction: Click “Launch Analysis” to submit the job.

steps.title: Monitor job status
steps.instruction: Watch for notifications indicating when the job is submitted, running, and completed.

steps.title: Locate output files
steps.instruction: After completion, open the output directory; it contains the main CSV file listing detected viral sequences with categories and metrics, plus additional result files in sub‑directories.

steps.title: Access or download results
steps.instruction: Open the CSV file directly in iPlant or download it for further downstream analysis.
